FilePrint.description: The last time a file was printed, and whether that print completed.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

ToolFilament.description: The filament one tool feeds, as a length and, when it is known, a volume.

length_mm.description: The length of filament fed, in millimetres.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

volume_cm3.description:
The volume of filament fed, in cubic centimetres, when the source
reported one.

description: One file the printer holds, as its source describes it.

failures.description: How many prints of the file did not, by the source's own tally.

filament.description:
The filament the source's analysis of the file says each tool uses.

Absent when the file has no analysis: one still pending, or a file the
source never analyses, such as one on an SD card.

file_name.description: The file's name, as the source reported it.

last_print.description: The file's most recent print, when it has been printed.

origin.description: Where the file lives, in the source's own vocabulary.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, when the source reported it.

successes.description: How many prints of the file completed, by the source's own tally.

title: FileFacts
